1006.description: Pull a band toward you with elbows flared wide. It targets the rear delts and upper back.
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height and hold the ends with arms extended.
Step back until the band is taut.
Pull your hands toward your chest with elbows high.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly without letting your shoulders round forward.

1070.description: Curl yourself toward the straps while leaning back. It works the biceps.
instructions: Hold the handles and lean back with arms extended.
Keep your body straight.
Bend your elbows to pull yourself up.
Squeeze the biceps.
Lower slowly.

1134.description: A straight-arm plank with feet in the straps and one leg lifted, which challenges core stability.
instructions: Put your feet in the straps and set a high plank.
Lift one leg slightly higher.
Keep your hips level and body straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower the leg and switch sides.
Breathe steadily throughout.

1198.description: A pull-up that uses a small jump to help you up, then a slow lowering phase. Good for building pulling strength.
instructions: Stand under a pull-up bar and grip it slightly wider than your shoulders.
Bend your knees and jump up, pulling your chin above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.
Reset on the floor and repeat.

1262.description: A one-arm decline chest fly with a cable. It trains the lower chest.
instructions: Attach a D-handle to a low pulley cable machine and set the bench to a decline angle.
Lie down on the bench with your head towards the machine and grab the handle with your right hand.
Extend your arm straight up above your chest, keeping a slight bend in your elbow.
With a controlled motion, lower your arm out to the side until your hand is in line with your shoulder.
Pause for a moment, then reverse the motion and bring your arm back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to your left arm and repeat the exercise.
instructionsZh: 将 D 形手柄连接到低滑轮绳索机器上，并将长凳设置为下降角度。
躺在长凳上，头朝向机器，用右手抓住手柄。
将手臂伸直至胸部上方，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
控制动作，将手臂向一侧放低，直到手与肩膀在一条直线上。
暂停片刻，然后反转动作并将手臂恢复到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后切换到左臂并重复练习。

1326.description: Hang from a bar with an underhand grip and pull until your chin clears it. A classic builder of the lats and biceps.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your palms facing towards you and your hands shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and pull your body up towards the bar, leading with your chest.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，手掌朝向自己，双手与肩同宽。
启动核心肌群，将身体拉向杠铃杆，以胸部为主导。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1390.description: Sit on a chair and reach to pull your toes toward you. It stretches the calf and the back of the lower leg.
instructions: Sit on the edge of a chair or bench with your feet flat on the ground.
Extend one leg straight out in front of you, keeping your heel on the ground.
Lean forward slightly, feeling a stretch in your calf muscle.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat the stretch.
instructionsZh: 坐在椅子或长凳的边缘，双脚平放在地面上。
将一只腿伸直在身前，脚跟保持在地面上。
稍微向前倾，感受小腿肌肉的拉伸。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒。
换腿并重复拉伸。

1454.description: A machine overhead press that builds the shoulders and triceps with a fixed, stable path.
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles start near shoulder height and sit with your back on the pad.
Grip the handles and brace your core.
Press the handles overhead until your arms are nearly straight.
Pause briefly at the top without shrugging.
Lower slowly back to shoulder height and repeat.

1518.description: A split squat with the back foot on a decline bench and a barbell on your back. It builds single-leg strength.
instructions: Place the bar on your upper back and rest one foot behind you on a decline bench.
Step the front foot out to set a stable stance.
Lower your back knee toward the floor, torso upright.
Drive through the front foot to rise.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

1582.description: Lying on your back, you hold your big toe with a rope and raise the leg straight. It stretches the hamstrings.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended and your arms by your sides.
Loop the rope around the ball of your right foot and hold the ends of the rope with your hands.
Slowly raise your right leg towards your chest, keeping your knee straight and your foot flexed.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds, then slowly lower your leg back down to the starting position.
Repeat with your left leg.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 仰卧，双腿伸展，双臂放在身体两侧。
将绳子绕在右脚掌上，并用手握住绳子的末端。
慢慢地将右腿抬向胸部，保持膝盖伸直，脚弯曲。
保持伸展几秒钟，然后慢慢将腿放回起始位置。
左腿重复上述动作。
继续交替双腿达到所需的重复次数。

1646.description: Alternating hammer curls on a preacher bench. It builds the brachialis and the biceps with strict form.
instructions: Sit on a preacher bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your torso and arms fully extended.
Keep your upper arms stationary and exhale as you curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbells until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在牧师凳上，双手各持一个哑铃，手掌面向躯干，双臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，在弯举哑铃时呼气，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复建议的重复次数。

1710.description: A partner-assisted stretch lying down for the glutes and piriformis. It releases deep hip tension.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended.
Bend your right knee and place your right ankle on your left thigh, just above the knee.
Grasp your left thigh with both hands and gently pull it towards your chest.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Release the stretch and repeat on the other side.
instructionsZh: 仰卧，双腿伸展。
弯曲右膝盖，将右脚踝放在左大腿上，就在膝盖上方。
用双手抓住左大腿，轻轻地将其拉向胸部。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒。
松开拉伸并在另一侧重复。

1774.description: A side bridge with a top leg lift. Works the outer hips and glutes plus the core.
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs extended and stacked on top of each other.
Prop yourself up on your forearm, keeping your elbow directly below your shoulder.
Engage your core and lift your hips off the ground, creating a straight line from your head to your feet.
While keeping your core engaged, lift your top leg as high as possible without rotating your hips.
Pause for a moment at the top, then lower your leg back down.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsZh: 侧躺，双腿伸展并叠放在一起。
用前臂支撑自己，将肘部保持在肩膀正下方。
启动你的核心并将臀部抬离地面，从头到脚形成一条直线。
在保持核心肌群参与的同时，尽可能高地抬起上面的那条腿，但不要旋转臀部。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后将腿放下。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

1838.description: Combines forward bending with a turn of the head to stretch the back and side of the neck.
instructions: Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Turn your head about 45 degrees to one side.
Rest a hand on the back of your head and ease your nose toward your armpit.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1902.description: Seated straddle that stretches the inner thighs.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs spread wide.
Keep your knees pointing up.
Hinge forward from the hips with a long spine.
Walk your hands forward until you feel the stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Come up slowly.

1966.description: Seated stretch pulling the toes back while turning the sole outward.
instructions: Sit and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the toes with your hand.
Pull the toes back toward your shin and turn the sole gently outward.
Feel the stretch along the sole and inner edge of the foot.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

2094.description: A gentle stretch for the thumb and the muscles at its base.
instructions: Extend one arm with the palm facing up.
Use your other hand to hold the thumb.
Gently pull the thumb back and away from the palm.
Stop at a mild stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

2158.description: A single leg bridge with a band and the free leg held straight, demanding strong glutes and a level pelvis.
instructions: Lie on your back with a band around your thighs and one knee bent, foot flat.
Extend the other leg straight, in line with your thigh.
Drive through the planted heel and lift your hips.
Keep your hips level and squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

2286.description: A machine hip extension that drives your leg back against resistance. Targets the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Adjust the machine to fit your body and sit on it with your back against the backrest.
Place your feet on the footrests and grip the handles for stability.
Engage your glutes and hamstrings, then push against the footrests to extend your hips and raise your legs backward.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整机器以适合您的身体，然后坐在机器上，背部靠在靠背上。
将脚放在脚踏板上并握住手柄以保持稳定。
启动臀肌和腿筋，然后推动脚踏板以伸展臀部并向后抬起双腿。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2350.description: A side-by-side form check for the starting position of a push-up, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructions: Set your hands on the floor under your shoulders and extend your legs back.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your body forms one straight line from head to heels with hands under the shoulders.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

2414.description: A one-arm barbell curl while standing, with the other hand resting on your thigh. Isolates the biceps.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell in one hand, palm facing up.
Rest your opposite hand on your thigh for support.
Keeping your upper arm stationary, exhale and curl the weight up towards your shoulder.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the weight back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，一手握住杠铃，掌心朝上。
将另一只手放在大腿上以获得支撑。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将重量向上弯向肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气并慢慢将重量放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

2734.description: Walking while carrying a heavy loaded bar at your sides. Builds grip strength, upper back and trunk stability.
instructions: Stand inside the loaded bar and grip the handle, then lift it to hang at your sides.
Keep your chest tall, shoulders back and core braced.
Walk forward with short, quick steps for a set distance.
Stop, lower the weights to the floor with a flat back, and rest.

2798.description: A barbell squat jump followed by a rear lunge. Builds explosive leg power.
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back.
Lower your body into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
Explode upwards, jumping off the ground as high as you can.
Land softly on your feet and immediately step back with one leg into a reverse lunge.
Lower your body down until your front thigh is parallel to the ground, keeping your back straight.
Push through your front heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat the jump and lunge sequence on the other leg.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先，双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将杠铃放在上背部。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，将身体降低至蹲姿。
向上爆炸，尽可能高地跳离地面。
双脚轻轻落地，然后立即单腿向后退一步，形成反向弓步。
降低身体，直到大腿前侧与地面平行，保持背部挺直。
推动前脚跟以返回到起始位置。
在另一条腿上重复跳跃和弓步序列。
继续交替双腿达到所需的重复次数。

2862.description: A leg-switching move lying on your back, building lower abdominal strength.
instructions: Lie on your back with your hips lifted and hands supporting them.
Raise your legs up.
Lower one leg while the other stays up.
Switch legs.
Keep the movement steady.

2926.description: Stepping sideways against a band anchored in an X pattern. It fires up the hips and outer glutes.
instructions: Cross the band into an X and place it around your feet or lower legs, holding the ends as needed.
Stand in a quarter squat with your chest up.
Step sideways, keeping tension on the band.
Bring the trailing foot in without letting your feet touch.
Walk the set distance, then return the other way.

2990.description: Walking on the balls of your feet with a barbell on your back to wake up the calves before heavy lower body training.
instructions: Rest a light barbell across your upper back and hold it with both hands.
Stand tall with your core braced and rise onto the balls of your feet.
Walk forward in small, controlled steps without letting your heels drop.
Keep your ankles steady and your hips level.
Walk 10-15 metres, rest, then repeat for a few rounds.
Use a light load so you can stay high on your toes.

3182.description: A frog-style glute bridge with extra weight on your hips for stronger glutes.
instructions: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees open.
Rest a weight on your hips.
Drive your hips up by squeezing your glutes.
Pause at the top.
Lower and repeat.

3310.description: The standard flat bench press with a loaded barbell, the staple lift for chest size and pressing strength.
instructions: Lie on the bench with eyes under the bar and feet flat on the floor.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width and unrack it over your chest.
Lower the bar under control to your mid chest.
Press it back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your shoulder blades pinched and your feet planted throughout.

3374.description: Drawing outward circles with the ropes, training shoulders and conditioning.
instructions: Stand with knees bent and a rope end in each hand.
Move your arms in circles that turn outward.
Keep the movement smooth and even.
Keep your core tight.
Continue for a set time.

3438.description: A leg raise on a decline bench, finishing with a hip lift for the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on a decline bench and hold the top edge.
Bring your legs up over your hips.
Lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips first.
Lower your legs with control.
Avoid swinging.

3502.description: A dynamic warm-up swinging one leg forward and back. It loosens the hips and hamstrings.
instructions: Stand tall beside a wall or support and hold it for balance.
Shift your weight onto the inside leg.
Swing the outside leg forward and back in a controlled arc.
Keep your torso upright.
Increase the range gradually.
Switch legs after your reps.

3566.description: Roll your upper back over a foam roller to loosen tight spots and improve thoracic mobility.
instructions: Sit with a foam roller behind your upper back and lie back onto it.
Cross your arms over your chest and lift your hips.
Roll slowly between your shoulder blades and mid back.
Pause on tender spots for a few breaths.
Avoid rolling your lower back and continue for about a minute.

3630.description: Fold forward from standing to lengthen the hamstrings and lower back.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip width apart.
Hinge forward at the hips with a long spine.
Let your arms hang toward the floor.
Keep your knees soft.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Release slowly and repeat on the other side if needed.

3694.description: A chest-supported reverse fly done one arm at a time, aimed at the rear delts and upper back.
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging.
Raise one arm out to the side with a soft elbow until it is level with your shoulder.
Squeeze your shoulder blade, then lower slowly.
Repeat with the other arm.
Keep your neck relaxed and avoid swinging.

3758.description: A standing chest press on a lever machine, pressing the handles forward. It builds the chest, shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and position your hands at chest level.
Push the handles forward until your arms are fully extended, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Pause for a moment, then slowly bring the handles back towards your chest, maintaining control throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度并将自己放在机器上，双脚平放在地面上。
正手握住手柄，并将双手置于胸部水平。
向前推动手柄，直到手臂完全伸展，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢地将手柄拉回到胸部，在整个动作过程中保持控制。
重复所需的重复次数。

3822.description: A rowing movement with small pulses at the top of the pull. It builds endurance in your upper back.
instructions: Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back and arms hanging.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Pulse in short movements at the top.
Lower your arms under control.
Keep your neck neutral.

3886.description: A flowing combo of push-up, row, clean and press that works the whole body with a pair of dumbbells.
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands on two dumbbells.
Do a push-up, then row one dumbbell to your ribs and switch sides.
Jump or step your feet toward your hands and stand up, cleaning the dumbbells to your shoulders.
Press them overhead.
Lower to the floor and return to the push-up position.
Move smoothly and keep your core tight.

3950.description: Move from a crawl position into a crab position to work the whole body.
instructions: Start on hands and knees.
Lift your knees slightly into a low crawl.
Rotate your body and sit back into a crab position, face up.
Lift your hips.
Rotate back into the crawl and repeat.

4014.description: A standing cable front raise. It targets the front delts with steady tension.
instructions: Stand facing away from a low pulley.
Hold the handle with a slight elbow bend.
Raise the arm to eye level.
Lower slowly.
Switch arms.

4078.description: Alternating single arm chest fly from a low anchor.
instructions: Anchor the band low behind you and hold the ends.
Stand in a staggered stance.
Sweep one arm up and across in front of your chest.
Return slowly.
Alternate arms.

4142.description: A lying pressdown with an underhand grip, targeting the triceps.
instructions: Lie on your back with the band anchored overhead and grip it palms up.
Keep your elbows pointing at the ceiling.
Press your hands down toward your thighs.
Squeeze your triceps.
Return slowly.

4206.description: A chin-up with a band under one knee to lighten the load. It builds lats and biceps on the way to full chin-ups.
instructions: Attach a band to a pull-up bar and place one knee in the loop.
Grab the bar with an underhand, shoulder-width grip.
Hang with your arms straight and your core tight.
Pull your chest up until your chin clears the bar.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.
Switch knees halfway through your sets.

4334.description: A side plank with a knee-to-elbow crunch. It trains the obliques and shoulder stability together.
instructions: Set up in a side plank on one forearm, feet stacked or staggered.
Put your free hand behind your head.
Bring your top knee and elbow together beneath your torso.
Extend back to the side plank position.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

4398.description: A squat with a resistance band for added load. It builds strength in the legs and hips.
instructions: Stand on the band with feet shoulder-width apart and hold the handles at your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your chest tall.
Sit your hips back and bend your knees to lower into a squat.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your feet to stand up.

4462.description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the foot sole. A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your foot sole while seated or standing.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

4590.description: A rising punch with the left hand thrown to a partner's pad, using leg and hip drive.
instructions: Face your partner, who holds a pad low in front of them.
Stand in a boxing stance and bend your knees slightly.
Dip slightly and drive up through your legs.
Rotate your hips as you bring your left fist up in a tight arc.
Hit the pad with the palm facing you.
Reset your guard.

4718.description: A chin-up with a band under your feet or knees to reduce the load. It helps you build toward unassisted reps.
instructions: Hang from a bar with an underhand grip and the band looped under your feet.
Engage your lats and keep your core tight.
Pull your chin over the bar.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight and repeat.

4782.description: A seated pull-up with a staggered grip, pulling your head to alternating sides of the bar. It trains the lats and grip.
instructions: Sit under a bar and grab it with one hand in front of the other.
Extend your legs in front of you.
Pull your body up and bring your head to one side.
Lower under control.
Alternate sides each rep or each set.

4846.description: A one-arm floor press with the kettlebell upside down. It demands stability in the wrist and shoulder.
instructions: Lie on the floor and hold a kettlebell upside down in one hand.
Keep your wrist straight and the bell steady.
Press it up to full extension.
Lower slowly until your upper arm touches the floor.
Switch sides after your reps.

4910.description: A static hold with the elbows bent and the dumbbells held in place. It builds endurance in the arms.
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand.
Curl the weights until your elbows are bent about 90 degrees.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Hold the position without letting the weights drop.
Breathe steadily during the hold.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then lower under control.

4974.description: An inverted row where you pull your body along the floor on sliders. It trains the back with core demand.
instructions: Lie under a bar or lower support with sliders under your heels.
Grab the bar overhand.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Keep your body straight.
Lower slowly.
Keep your hips up.

5038.description: Jumping rope with two passes of the rope per jump. It is great conditioning that builds coordination.
instructions: Hold a jump rope with the handles at your hips.
Jump slightly higher than normal.
Spin the rope fast with your wrists so it passes twice under your feet.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Rest between short rounds as needed.

5166.description: A one-legged jump onto a box. It builds explosive power and single-leg control.
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy box on one foot.
Swing your arms and dip into a short quarter squat.
Jump up and land softly on the box on the same foot.
Stand tall, then step down carefully.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

5998.description: A lying leg lift that trains the inner thigh of the left leg.
instructions: Lie on your left side with your legs straight.
Bend your right knee and place that foot in front of you.
Raise your left leg a few inches off the floor.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat, then switch sides.

6318.description: A lunge stepping one leg back and across behind you. It targets the glutes and outer hips.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step one leg diagonally behind the other.
Bend both knees and lower your hips.
Keep your chest up and front knee over your toes.
Push up and return, then switch sides.

6510.description: A one-arm row from a high cable, pulling toward your torso to train the upper back and lats.
instructions: Set a cable to a high position and hold the handle with one hand.
Brace your core and stand or kneel tall.
Pull the handle toward your torso, driving your elbow back.
Squeeze your shoulder blade at the end.
Return slowly, then switch arms.

6766.description: Rolling a ball under the inner lower leg while lying on your side. It releases the deep calf muscle that supports the arch.
instructions: Lie on your side with a small ball under the inside of your lower leg.
Support yourself with your hands and the other leg.
Slowly roll the leg along the ball from calf toward ankle.
Pause on tender spots with light pressure.
Breathe and relax the leg.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch legs.

6958.description: A side-to-side jump over a low hurdle. It builds explosive power and quick landings.
instructions: Stand beside a low hurdle with feet together.
Swing your arms and jump sideways over it.
Land softly on both feet with knees bent.
Jump straight back over the other way.
Keep your ground contact quick and controlled.

7278.description: Hanging stretch using straps that opens the sides of your back and your shoulders.
instructions: Hold the straps and lean back with straight arms.
Sit your hips back and drop your chest between your arms.
Feel the stretch along the sides of your back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return slowly to standing.

7342.description: Wide-stance plank with alternating side taps that challenge core stability.
instructions: Start in a high plank with feet wider than your hips.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Lift one hand and tap your opposite hip or thigh.
Return the hand and tap with the other side.
Move slowly without rocking.

7598.description: A Bulgarian split squat with one dumbbell held in the opposite hand to the front leg.
instructions: Hold one dumbbell in the hand opposite your front leg.
Put your back foot on a bench and step the front foot forward.
Lean your torso forward slightly.
Lower until the front thigh is parallel.
Drive up through the front heel.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

7854.description: A side plank with a twist that ends in an arm raise. It challenges your obliques and shoulders.
instructions: Set up in a side plank on your forearm.
Raise your top arm up toward the ceiling.
Rotate and thread your arm under your torso.
Open back up and raise the arm again.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

8366.description: A swing performed to the side of the body that hits the obliques and hips while the legs drive the kettlebell.
instructions: Stand with feet wider than hips and hold a kettlebell with both hands.
Hinge at the hips and swing the bell between your legs.
Drive your hips forward and swing it up and across to one side.
Let it fall back through your legs and swing to the other side.
Keep your back flat throughout.

8622.description: A seated press angled upward to emphasise the upper chest.
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Start with your hands near your chest.
Press them diagonally up and forward until your arms are straight.
Lower back to the chest slowly.

8750.description: An advanced ring move that sweeps the body over the rings, working the lats and core.
instructions: Hang from the rings with an overhand grip.
Pull your hips up and bring your knees to your chest.
Rotate backward, pulling the body over the rings.
Lower under control.
Keep the movement smooth.

8878.description: Hinged forward at about 45 degrees, you pull the cable handles apart in a wide arc. It targets the rear shoulders and upper back.
instructions: Set two cable handles at a low or mid height and grab them crossed over.
Hinge forward at the hips to about 45 degrees with a flat back.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Pull the handles out and back in a wide arc until your arms are in line with your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blades gently at the end.
Return slowly and keep your torso still.

9070.description: Small, quick hops off the balls of both feet. It builds calf and ankle stiffness and bounce.
instructions: Stand tall with your knees nearly straight.
Hop off the balls of your feet.
Keep your heels off the ground.
Bounce quickly with minimal knee bend.
Stay light and quiet on landing.
Go for a set time or number of hops.

9518.description: A dead bug combined with a kettlebell pullover, where arms and legs extend in opposite directions.
instructions: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell above your chest and knees at tabletop.
Brace your core and keep your lower back down.
Lower the kettlebell overhead while extending the opposite leg.
Return to the start under control.
Switch sides and repeat.

10094.description: A one-arm clean where the dumbbell travels across your body to the opposite shoulder.
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell hanging in front of your thigh, hips hinged slightly.
Drive your hips forward and shrug.
Pull the dumbbell up and across your body.
Catch it at the opposite shoulder.
Lower it back to the hang.
Finish reps, then switch arms.

10542.description: The same hugging knee flexion, using a towel around the shin to help. It adds a gentle assisted bend.
instructions: Sit tall on a chair and loop a towel around one shin.
Hold the towel ends with both hands.
Pull the knee gently toward your chest, bending it.
Hold for a moment, then release.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

10670.description: A one-arm incline press on a lever machine. Working one side at a time evens out strength differences.
instructions: Sit on the machine and grab one handle at upper-chest height.
Brace your core to avoid twisting.
Press the handle forward and up.
Pause, then lower slowly.
Keep your shoulder pulled back.
Do all reps, then switch arms.

10734.description: A one-legged stand on a foam balance pad. It improves ankle stability and body control.
instructions: Place the pad on a flat floor.
Step on with one foot and stand tall.
Lift the other foot off the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your eyes on a fixed point.
Switch legs.

10862.description: A single-leg hinge with a ball against the wall for balance. It trains hamstrings and balance.
instructions: Stand facing a wall with a ball between your hand and the wall.
Lift one foot slightly.
Hinge at the hip as the free leg extends back.
Keep your back flat.
Return to standing.
Switch legs after the set.

10926.description: A wall-supported quarter squat that you hold. It gently loads the thighs.
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and feet slightly forward.
Slide down until your knees bend about a quarter of the way.
Keep your back flat to the wall.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.
Slide back up.

11054.description: A plate-loaded machine hip thrust with a staggered stance. It targets the glutes.
instructions: Sit in the machine with the pad over your hips.
Stagger your feet.
Drive through your heels.
Lift your hips fully.
Squeeze your glutes.
Lower slowly and switch the stance.

11374.description: A side-lying stretch that opens up the back of the shoulder. Handy for keeping internal rotation smooth.
instructions: Lie on your side with the bottom arm in front of you, elbow bent to 90 degrees.
Keep your shoulder stacked and the upper arm at chest height.
Use your top hand to gently press the bottom forearm toward the floor.
Stop where you feel a mild stretch at the back of the shoulder.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

0046.description: A squat holding the bar behind your legs. Puts extra work on the quads and glutes.
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and your toes slightly turned out.
Hold the barbell behind your legs, resting it on your upper thighs.
Lower your body by bending at the knees and hips, keeping your back straight and your chest up.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾稍微向外。
将杠铃放在腿后面，将其放在大腿上部。
弯曲膝盖和臀部，降低身体，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
继续降低，直到大腿与地面平行，或者尽可能低。
暂停片刻，然后用力推动脚后跟，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0110.description: A standing curl with an overhand grip. Trains the biceps, brachialis and forearms.
instructions: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with an underhand grip, palms facing up.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and your upper arms stationary.
Exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps, bringing the barbell as close to your shoulders as possible.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽，反手握住杠铃，手掌朝上。
保持肘部靠近躯干，上臂保持静止。
呼气并弯举杠铃，同时收缩二头肌，使杠铃尽可能靠近肩膀。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0174.description: A rotational cable move where you sweep the handle across the body and up over the shoulder. It builds twisting power and trains the core and obliques.
instructions: Stand facing the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the cable handle with both hands at chest level, palms facing down.
Engage your core and rotate your torso to the right, pulling the cable across your body.
As you rotate, pivot your back foot and allow your hips to rotate naturally.
Extend your arms fully and finish the movement by flipping the cable handle over your shoulder.
Return to the starting position by reversing the movement, rotating your torso back to the center.
Repeat the movement on the opposite side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 面对电缆机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
用双手握住电缆手柄，使其与胸部齐平，手掌朝下。
启动你的核心并将你的躯干向右旋转，将电缆拉过你的身体。
当你旋转时，转动后脚并让臀部自然旋转。
充分伸展双臂，将绳索手柄翻转到肩膀上来完成动作。
通过反向运动返回起始位置，将躯干旋转回中心。
在另一侧重复该动作。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

0238.description: A straight-arm pulldown with a bar on a high pulley. Sweeping the bar to the thighs isolates the lats.
instructions: Attach a straight bar to the high pulley of a cable machine.
Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, keeping your arms straight and your palms facing down.
Engage your lats and pull the bar down towards your thighs, keeping your arms straight throughout the movement.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly return the bar to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将直杆连接到缆绳机的高滑轮上。
面向机器站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
正手握住杠铃，保持手臂伸直，手掌朝下。
收紧背阔肌并将杠铃向下拉向大腿，在整个运动过程中保持手臂伸直。
在底部暂停片刻，然后慢慢地将杠铃返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0302.description: A dumbbell fly on a decline bench. The arms open in a wide arc to stretch and train the lower chest.
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured and your head lower than your hips.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing each other and your arms extended above your chest.
Lower the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Pause for a moment, then squeeze your chest muscles to bring the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 躺在倾斜的长凳上，双脚固定，头部低于臀部。
双手各握一个哑铃，手掌相对，双臂伸至胸部上方。
将哑铃以宽弧线向两侧放低，直到感觉到胸部有拉伸感。
暂停片刻，然后挤压胸部肌肉，使哑铃回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0366.description: One forearm rests over a bench with the palm facing in, and you move the dumbbell with the wrist. A grip and forearm builder done one side at a time.
instructions: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in one hand and your arm extended over the bench, palm facing up.
Keep your upper arm stationary and curl the dumbbell towards your shoulder, keeping your wrist in a neutral position.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，一只手拿着哑铃，手臂伸过长凳，手掌朝上。
保持上臂静止，将哑铃向肩膀弯曲，使手腕保持在中立位置。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

0430.description: Standing, you lower a dumbbell behind your head and press it back up. It builds the back of the upper arm.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in one hand.
Raise the dumbbell overhead, keeping your arm straight.
Bend your elbow and lower the dumbbell behind your head, keeping your upper arm stationary.
Extend your arm back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，一只手握住哑铃。
将哑铃举过头顶，保持手臂伸直。
弯曲肘部，将哑铃放到脑后，保持上臂静止。
将手臂向后伸展至起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0494.description: An incline push-up with your palms facing back. It trains the chest and shoulders in a different way.
instructions: Place your hands on the edge of a bench or elevated surface, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Extend your legs behind you, resting on the balls of your feet, creating a straight line from your head to your heels.
Lower your chest towards the bench by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the starting position by extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将双手放在长凳或高架表面的边缘，距离略宽于肩宽。
将双腿伸到身后，放在脚掌上，从头到脚跟形成一条直线。
弯曲肘部，将胸部向长凳方向降低，使其靠近身体两侧。
在底部暂停片刻，然后伸展双臂将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0558.description: A pull-up bar move where you use a swing to get above the bar and then press out. Trains lats, arms and chest, and needs good control.
instructions: Start by hanging from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and use a swinging motion to generate momentum.
As you swing forward, pull your chest towards the bar, using your lats and biceps to initiate the movement.
Continue the upward motion until your chest reaches the bar, then transition into a dip position by pushing down on the bar and extending your arms.
Lower yourself back down to the starting position by bending your arms and controlling the descent.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先，用正手握法悬挂在引体向上杆上，双手分开的距离略大于肩宽。
启动你的核心并使用摆动动作来产生动力。
当你向前挥杆时，将胸部拉向杠铃，用背阔肌和二头肌开始动作。
继续向上运动，直到胸部到达杠铃，然后向下推杠铃并伸展手臂，过渡到双臂屈伸姿势。
弯曲手臂并控制下降，将自己放回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0622.description: Alternating small leg kicks while lying down. It challenges the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Lie on your back with hands under your hips.
Lift both legs a few inches off the floor.
Raise one leg higher while the other stays low.
Switch legs in a smooth scissor motion.
Keep your lower back pressed to the floor.
Breathe steadily throughout.

0686.description: A rotating move with your upper back on a stability ball and arms straight. It targets the obliques and core stability.
instructions: Lie with your upper back on a stability ball.
Lift your hips so your body is flat like a table.
Extend your arms straight above your chest.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Return to center and rotate to the other side.
Keep your hips lifted throughout.

0750.description: On the smith machine, you squat down until you touch a chair. Works the quads and glutes with a clear depth marker.
instructions: Adjust the height of the smith machine bar to a comfortable position.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
Place the barbell across your upper back, resting it on your traps.
Engage your core and keep your chest up as you slowly lower your body by bending your knees and hips.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将史密斯机杆的高度调整到舒适的位置。
站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾稍微向外。
将杠铃放在上背部，放在斜方肌上。
通过弯曲膝盖和臀部慢慢降低身体，收紧核心并保持挺胸。
继续降低，直到大腿与地面平行，或者尽可能低。
暂停片刻，然后用力推动脚后跟，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0814.description: A triceps dip using the edge of a bench or chair, lowering the body and pressing back up. It builds the triceps.
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench or chair with your hands gripping the edge, fingers pointing forward.
Slide your butt off the bench, supporting your weight with your hands.
Bend your elbows and lower your body towards the ground, keeping your back close to the bench.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳或椅子的边缘，双手抓住边缘，手指指向前方。
将臀部滑离长凳，用手支撑体重。
弯曲肘部，将身体放低至地面，保持背部靠近长凳。
在底部暂停片刻，然后将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0878.description: A deep back squat performed in a power rack for safety. It builds strength across the legs and hips.
instructions: Set the bar at upper chest height in a rack and step under it, resting it on your upper back.
Unrack and step back with your feet shoulder width apart.
Bend your hips and knees and squat down as deep as you comfortably can.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your whole foot to stand back up.
Set the safety pins just below your lowest depth.

0942.description: Round your spine upward from hands and knees to stretch the back. A gentle way to loosen the spine and wake up the core.
instructions: Start on all fours with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips.
Exhale and press the floor away as you round your back toward the ceiling.
Tuck your chin toward your chest and draw your belly in.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
Inhale and return to a neutral back.
